original.label: OVERCLAIM
original.reason: The final assessment states the pledge was delivered by 2025, but the excerpts only show Apple was over 99% toward the goal in an April 2025 statement and that by April 2026 Apple 'now'/'today' uses 100% recycled cobalt in all Apple-designed batteries; they do not establish when full achievement occurred within 2025.

conditions.label: NEUTRAL

quote_checks.quote: Earlier this year, Apple surpassed 99 percent on the way toward its 2025 goals to use 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets and 100 percent recycled cobalt in all Apple-designed batteries.
quote_checks.label: NEUTRAL
quote_checks.reason: This shows Apple had not yet stated full 100% achievement at that earlier 2025 point; being above 99% does not establish reaching 100% by end of 2025.

quote_checks.quote: On top of hitting 30 percent recycled content across all of its products shipped in 2025, Apple also reached several targets for recycled content in select components last year.
quote_checks.label: NEUTRAL
quote_checks.reason: This says several select-component targets were reached in 2025, but it does not identify the cobalt-in-all-Apple-designed-batteries target specifically.

quote_checks.quote: As part of this work, Apple now uses 100 percent recycled cobalt in all the batteries it designs and 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets.
quote_checks.label: NEUTRAL
quote_checks.reason: This establishes present achievement as of the 2026 statement, not that the 100% level was reached by the end of 2025.

quote_checks.quote: Today, all batteries designed by Apple are made with 100 percent recycled cobalt, and all magnets are made with 100 percent recycled rare earth elements.
quote_checks.label: NEUTRAL
quote_checks.reason: Like 'now,' 'Today' shows current status at the time of the 2026 statement, without fixing achievement to 2025 year-end.

conditions.reason: The record establishes the pledge and later full achievement, but it does not pin that full achievement to by the end of 2025 under the stated battery scope/accounting method.

result.label: UNDERCLAIM
result.reason: The final assessment says the evidence does not establish delivery, but April 2026 excerpts stating Apple 'now uses' and 'Today, all batteries designed by Apple are made with 100 percent recycled cobalt,' combined with the same article’s reference to products shipped and targets reached 'last year' (2025), support that Apple had achieved the pledged all-Apple-designed-batteries cobalt target by the end of 2025; its stated evidence gap is therefore too skeptical.

quote_checks.label: ENTAILMENT
quote_checks.reason: This directly establishes full achievement for the pledged battery scope, though in present tense as of the 2026 statement.

quote_checks.quote: Today, all batteries designed by Apple are made with 100 percent recycled cobalt, and all magnets are made with 100 percent recycled rare earth elements.
quote_checks.label: ENTAILMENT
quote_checks.reason: This independently states complete achievement across all Apple-designed batteries as of the 2026 report.

quote_checks.quote: On top of hitting 30 percent recycled content across all of its products shipped in 2025, Apple also reached several targets for recycled content in select components last year.
quote_checks.label: ENTAILMENT
quote_checks.reason: In the same April 2026 report, 'last year' refers to 2025 and indicates Apple had reached recycled-content targets during 2025, supporting that the all-batteries recycled-cobalt achievement had been reached by end-2025.

conditions.reason: The 2026 Apple report states all Apple-designed batteries use 100 percent recycled cobalt, and the same report ties recycled-content target attainment to 'last year' (2025), which together establishes delivery of the 2025 all-batteries cobalt target.
